label: live-demo
alert: High p95 latency on frontend-proxy: 10958.3 ms (baseline 4892.9 ms); High p95 latency on product-catalog: 15000.0 ms (no baseline yet) [ongoing 8 min]
summary: The product-catalog service is suffering from severe memory starvation, causing extreme latency across the application.
symptoms: High p95 latency on frontend-proxy and product-catalog.
Slow frontend requests waiting on product-catalog.

root_cause.description: The product-catalog container is severely memory-constrained (20MiB limit), leading to resource starvation and high latency for all dependent services.

evidence.explanation: The product-catalog container is experiencing extreme memory pressure, with usage consistently hitting 99-100% of its 20MiB limit.
The product-catalog service shows p95 latency of 15000ms, which is the maximum observed in the service overview.
Traces show that frontend requests are waiting for product-catalog for tens of seconds, confirming it as the bottleneck.

ruled_out: The database (astronomy-db) is healthy and responding quickly to queries, so it is not the cause of the latency.
The checkout service's restart count is a pre-existing background issue and not the primary cause of the current latency incident.

proposed_action.reason: the runbook has no approved action for 'resource_starvation'; escalating to a human

prevention: Increase the memory limit for the product-catalog container to accommodate its workload and prevent resource starvation.
